# Copilot instructions — awesome-motion-design-agent-skills

Public, CC0, web-first curated list plus installable Agent Skills (`skills/*/SKILL.md`).

- Scope for Copilot: link rot, metadata pulses (stars/license/archived via GitHub API), frontmatter fixes, Dependabot/Actions bumps. Editorial additions and skill rewrites go to a human-reviewed PR.
- Never add private paths, credentials, internal strategy, affiliate links, or unverified tools. `skills-validate` fails on local paths.
- Every catalog entry: primary URL, one-sentence distinct value, license, dated pulse. Curate aggressively; no link dumps.
- Keep `<!-- fleet:*:start/end -->` blocks untouched — they are synced from the fleet control plane.
- Skill folder name == frontmatter `name`, kebab-case; description says *when it fires*, ≤1024 chars.
- A PR is done when Link Checker and Skills Validate are green. Keep PRs single-purpose; no WIP drafts left open >72h.
